description.p: Soplos Welcome Live is the first thing you see in the Soplos Linux live session. Install Soplos, repair a system you already have without knowing any command, partition disks and change the language and keyboard of the session.

Soplos Welcome Live es lo primero que ves en la sesión live de Soplos Linux. Instala Soplos, repara un sistema que ya tengas sin saber ningún comando, particiona discos y cambia el idioma y el teclado de la sesión.

Soplos Welcome Live est la première chose que vous voyez dans la session live de Soplos Linux. Installez Soplos, réparez un système que vous avez déjà sans connaître aucune commande, partitionnez des disques et changez la langue et le clavier de la session.

Soplos Welcome Live ist das Erste, was du in der Live-Sitzung von Soplos Linux siehst. Installiere Soplos, repariere ein vorhandenes System ohne einen einzigen Befehl zu kennen, partitioniere Festplatten und ändere Sprache und Tastatur der Sitzung.

O Soplos Welcome Live é a primeira coisa que vê na sessão live do Soplos Linux. Instale o Soplos, repare um sistema que já tenha sem saber nenhum comando, particione discos e altere o idioma e o teclado da sessão.

Soplos Welcome Live è la prima cosa che vedi nella sessione live di Soplos Linux. Installa Soplos, ripara un sistema che hai già senza conoscere alcun comando, partiziona i dischi e cambia la lingua e la tastiera della sessione.

Soplos Welcome Live este primul lucru pe care îl vezi în sesiunea live Soplos Linux. Instalează Soplos, repară un sistem pe care îl ai deja fără să știi nicio comandă, partiționează discuri și schimbă limba și tastatura sesiunii.

Soplos Welcome Live — первое, что вы видите в live-сессии Soplos Linux. Установите Soplos, почините уже установленную систему, не зная ни одной команды, разметьте диски и измените язык и клавиатуру сессии.

description.p: First stable release. The Language page comes right after Home in the sidebar.
The language switcher at the bottom of the sidebar changes the language of the system, as the Language page does, after a confirmation, and not only the language of the window.

Install launches Soplos Linux Installer, the new installer of Soplos, instead of Calamares. The rescue repairs the boot loader the system has, GRUB, Limine or systemd-boot, and rebuilds the start files so systemd-boot gets them too. Turning NumLock off in the tools works with the new installer.

The Install page checks the connection to the Soplos servers and the clock of the computer before the installer starts, because a missing connection or a wrong clock make it stop with error 100, and offers to fix the time. The Language and keyboard page has regions (Spain and Latin America, Brazil, Belgium, Austria, Australia and more) and keyboards for them. The Rescue page has a Help button that explains each option, and every page has a banner.
First beta. The system rescue, the password change and the repair of the initramfs and GRUB work in a live session of Soplos Linux Tyson.
System rescue mounts the /boot, /boot/efi and /home partitions of the installed system again, and stops instead of repairing the wrong folder when /boot is not mounted.
The application metadata points to the installed launcher, and the manual page is the same in the project and in the package.

First alpha of the rewrite of Soplos Welcome Live, from Python 3 and GTK3 to Tauri 2 with a Rust backend and a Svelte frontend, with the layout of Soplos Welcome 3.0 and a simpler rescue. It has not yet been tested on real hardware.
